description: Remove duplicate IoT sensor readings caused by batch replays. Two rows are duplicates when they share (device_id, reading_ts, metric). Keep exactly one row per key: the row from the highest batch_id whose value is not NULL; if all values for the key are NULL keep the row from the highest batch_id. Only readings from devices present in the devices table are kept. Output columns: device_id (STRING), reading_ts (TIMESTAMP), metric (STRING), value (FLOAT64), batch_id (INT64).

value.description: Measured value; NULL when the sensor failed

edge_cases: Same timestamp but different metric is not a duplicate
A newer batch with a NULL value must not overwrite an older non-NULL value
Readings from unregistered devices (d9) are dropped
Key where every replay has NULL value keeps a single NULL row
common_failure_modes: FM3: SELECT DISTINCT * keeps both rows because batch_id differs
FM5: ORDER BY batch_id DESC alone lets a newer NULL value replace a valid older reading
FM3: Omitting metric from PARTITION BY collapses temperature and humidity into one row
